- 修复部分 Java 环境下中文文件名、路径及错误详情显示乱码的问题，统一加固、签名与环境探测的 Java 工具输出编码。
- 保留中文证书 Alias 兼容，不修改系统 Java 环境、配置或加固协议；最低仍需完整 JDK 8。
- 从 rc.2 起补齐用户确认错误报告：增加有限错误摘要、精确执行步骤、路径字符特征与可用环境版本，不上传原始日志或真实路径；旧客户端报告仍兼容。
- rc.3 放宽 Android 4.4 工控模式的混合 ABI 输入限制，同一 APK 可保留四种主流架构，旧 `armeabi` 须单次确认排除；4.4 仅支持 v7a／NEON，arm64、x86、x86_64 用于 5.0+，不支持 4.4 x86。继续严格检查壳库完整性。
- 混合 ABI 的本地加固、签名及资源一致性回归通过；本候选版用于实际工控板与较新设备的同包验证，尚不宣称所有第三方 Native 功能或跨设备回归已通过。Windows 桌面版需 Windows 10 及以上（64 位）。
- 已通过 JDK 8/11/17 回归及真实中文名 APK 加固、签名验证；本候选版邀请受影响用户重点验证 Windows 原生场景，尚不宣称其签名识别失败已全部解决。

- Fixed garbled Chinese filenames, paths and error details in some Java environments by unifying Java tool output encoding across hardening, signing and environment detection.
- Retained Chinese certificate alias compatibility without changing system Java settings, configuration or the protection format. A full JDK 8 or newer is still required.
- Starting with rc.2, opt-in error reports include allowlisted summaries, precise execution steps, path character flags and available environment versions, without raw logs or actual paths. Older reports remain supported.
- rc.3 allows mixed supported ABIs in industrial mode, with explicit per-task removal of legacy `armeabi`. Android 4.4 remains limited to v7a/NEON; arm64, x86 and x86_64 require Android 5.0+. Android 4.4 x86 is not supported. Stub completeness checks remain enforced.
- Local mixed-ABI hardening, signing and resource consistency checks passed. This candidate is for validating the same APK on actual industrial and newer devices; full third-party native functionality and cross-device regression remain unverified. The Windows desktop app requires 64-bit Windows 10 or later.
- Tested with JDK 8/11/17 and a real APK using Chinese filenames. This release candidate seeks validation on affected Windows environments; not all reported signature detection failures are confirmed resolved.
